statement:
{V} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace ℂ V] [LinearAlgebraGame.InnerProductSpace_v V] (u v w : V) (c : ℂ)
  (h_decomp : u = c • v + w) (h_ortho : LinearAlgebraGame.orthogonal (c • v) w) : ‖u‖ ^ 2 = ‖c • v‖ ^ 2 + ‖w‖ ^ 2
name: LinearAlgebraGame.norm_sq_decomposition
content:
`norm_sq_decomposition` is a helper proof that if `u = c • v + w` and `c • v` is orthogonal
to `w`, then `‖u‖^2 = ‖c • v‖^2 + ‖w‖^2`. The syntax is
`norm_sq_decomposition u v w c h_decomp h_ortho`.
